title: bouteloua papillosa
intro: Bouteloua papillosa, commonly known as Blue Grama Grass, is a perennial grass native to the Great Plains region of North America. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing several health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving respiratory health, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Bouteloua papillosa include its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its therapeutic effects.
